paraphrase: Matthew reports that Jesus instructs his disciples that a brother who sins and will not listen to one, then to two or three witnesses, is to be reported to the ekklēsia, and if he will not listen even to the ekklēsia he is to be as a Gentile and a tax collector; and that he says to them: whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven. Textual report only.
